text_en: Rejoice in the Lord , O you righteous. Praise befits the upright.
text_cn: 义人，你们应向上主踊跃欢呼， 因为正直的人，理应赞美上主。

text_en: Praise the Lord with the lyre; make melody to him with the harp of ten strings.
text_cn: 你们该弹琴，称谢上主， 弹奏十弦琴，赞颂上主。

text_en: Sing to him a new song; play skillfully on the strings, with loud shouts.
text_cn: 你们应向他高唱新歌， 在欢呼声中奏琴吟咏，

text_en: For the word of the Lord is upright, and all his work is done in faithfulness.
text_cn: 因为上主的言语是正直的， 他的一切作为都是忠实的；

text_en: He loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of the steadfast love of the Lord .
text_cn: 他爱护正义和公理， 他的慈爱弥漫大地。

text_en: By the word of the Lord the heavens were made, and all their host by the breath of his mouth.
text_cn: 因天主的一句话，诸天造成； 因上主的一口气，万象生成。

text_en: He gathered the waters of the sea as in a bottle; he put the deeps in storehouses.
text_cn: 他把海水好似聚于皮囊， 他将汪洋好似贮于池塘。

text_en: Let all the earth fear the Lord ; let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
text_cn: 愿整个大地敬畏上主， 愿普世居民畏惧上主，

text_en: For he spoke, and it came to be; he commanded, and it stood firm.
text_cn: 因为他一发言，万有造成， 他一出命，各物生成。

text_en: The Lord brings the counsel of the nations to nothing; he frustrates the plans of the peoples.
text_cn: 上主使异邦的计划无绪， 使万民的策略废去。

text_en: The counsel of the Lord stands forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
text_cn: 上主的计划却永恒不变， 他心中的谋略万世常传。

text_en: Happy is the nation whose God is the Lord , the people whom he has chosen as his heritage.
text_cn: 尊上主为自己天主的民族，真是有福！ 上主选为自己产业的百姓，真是有福！

text_en: The Lord looks down from heaven; he sees all humankind.
text_cn: 上主由高天监临， 注视亚当的子孙；

text_en: From where he sits enthroned he watches all the inhabitants of the earth—
text_cn: 他由自己的居处， 视察大地的众庶：

text_en: he who fashions the hearts of them all, and observes all their deeds.
text_cn: 他既创造了众人的心灵， 当然知晓人的一切言行。

text_en: A king is not saved by his great army; a warrior is not delivered by his great strength.
text_cn: 帝王不是因兵多而取胜， 勇士不是因力大而保命。

text_en: The war horse is a vain hope for victory, and by its great might it cannot save.
text_cn: 为获胜利，骏马仍是徒然， 气力虽大，依旧难获安全。

text_en: Truly the eye of the Lord is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his steadfast love,
text_cn: 请看，上主的眼睛常关注敬畏他的人， 他的双目常眷顾靠他仁慈的人，

text_en: to deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.
text_cn: 为使他们的性命，脱免死亡， 使他们在饥馑时，生活如常。

text_en: Our soul waits for the Lord ; he is our help and shield.
text_cn: 我们的灵魂仰望着上主， 他是我们的保障和扶助；

text_en: Our heart is glad in him, because we trust in his holy name.
text_cn: 我们的心灵要因他而喜乐欢畅， 在他的圣名内寄托我们的希望。

text_en: Let your steadfast love, O Lord , be upon us, even as we hope in you.
text_cn: 上主，求你向我们广施慈爱， 有如我们对你所存的期待。
